Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the packet. A few specific items from Acme AP to make the vendor record and invoice acceptance straightforward: 

1) PO requirements
- We require the PO number on the invoice header and in the metadata (Invoice -> PO Number).
- For split POs, include line numbers that map to our PO lines (we use numeric line IDs).

2) GL/line mapping
- Prefer per-line mapping in an additional CSV if line-level reconciliation is required. If not, PO-level reference is acceptable for small pilot invoices.

3) Vendor record fields
- Legal company name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- VAT/TIN: please provide formatted VAT and local tax IDs — we need them to create the legal entity in our systems.

4) Remit & transfer
- Preferred channel: SFTP drop (PGP encrypted) to our inbound folder. Email remit is accepted for low-volume exceptions.

5) VAT handling
- For EU entities the reverse-charge rule applies where relevant. For invoicing: show net amount, then a VAT line indicating "reverse charge - VAT to be accounted by recipient" where applicable.

6) Cutoffs / posting
- Files received before 17:00 CET will be processed same-day in our next batch.

I’ve attached a sample PO for the pilot (PO-88421.pdf) and will need a test invoice and the SFTP endpoint + test creds from your side. Also, please confirm if Redwood can emit an XML invoice in UBL or our CSV template — that speeds ingestion.

Thanks,
Sophie Clarke
AP Manager — Acme Transit
